question: selling car logbook in different name
answer: Based on the given passages, it is not advisable to sell a car using a log book in a different name, as the registration document (V5) is not proof of ownership. The name on the log book may not match the name of the actual owner, as the car could be owned by a lease company, finance company, or someone else. Additionally, filling out the log book in a different name could be considered fraudulent. Therefore, I cannot answer the question of how to sell a car using a log book in a different name based on the given passages.

Filling in the log book when selling to a private individual. The first step is that you will need to fill in your car's log book also known as a V5C certificate. Turn to section 6 of the log book entitled new keeper or new name/new address details and fill in the details of the buyer.Then turn to section 8 of the same log book and, along with your buyer, sign the declaration contained in this section.illing out your log book when selling to a trader. When selling to a motor trader, rather than to an individual, you complete and hand over a different section called the V5C/3. In these cases you must also get the contact details and signature of the trader and post them to the DVLA at the same address as above.
